_doc: THE CPU fault table: one record, every consumer is read from it or generated from it by tools/gen_faults.py (rt/fnvl_faults.h: the FNVL_* codes; rt/seh_faults.inc: the case rows of rt/seh.cc fnvl_raise; fnvlift/faults.py: dsl.FAULTS / FLT_STATUS / lift_dsl.FAULT_MAP). code = the ONE number (the Form kind and the runtime code are the same). Columns: name; code; form = a Form may raise it (dsl kind); alias = runtime name when the row is another row's form-level variant; status = NTSTATUS; at = the address handed to the runtime relative to the instruction (a = the instruction, nxt = the next instruction, a+1 = the imm8 byte of a 2-byte int); trap = raised as a trap (raise_site trap); np = ExceptionInformation count; eip = Context.Eip relative to the given address (0 or 1); custom = the case body is hand code in rt/seh.cc (its label is still generated); entry = raise_av for the access-violation path (not a fnvl_raise code); the vector and the user-callable int gates are NOT here (platform/declared/x86sys.json). Sources: Windows 7 trap table as transcribed by ReactOS ntoskrnl/ke/i386/traphdlr.c and Wine 9.0 dlls/ntdll/unix/signal_i386.c (segv_handler / trap_handler / handle_interrupt / get_fpu_code), as cited per row.
